capabilities.detail: evaluate_native in native_evaluate.py; explicit geometry/task/output and scalar input target path, not native_api.py.

fixed_rigid square/circle, body node ux/uy fixed to zero; center on upper y-symmetry, reference passive_void cells, original staircase boundary. This is fixed-body overlay, not an existing generalized rigid-body coordinate.
One b_in mean displacement and scalar R_input reaction; output b_out measures q_out and generic spring. Native schema currently requires zero output/auxiliary spring.
Same-task suffix or explicit append-only targets, selected anchor fresh F/T; saved matrices not restored; only authorized path/metadata exceptions and new clock.
Original fixed-body weak forces/holding/masks/moments and study reader are available; reporting does not actuate a body, apply an external load or qualify grip.

gaps.current_gap: No body generalized q/rotation or tied rigid kinematics in the current native task/Project. Unlocking565 body nodes leaves source medium material and allows deformation; kind renaming is rejected, or misleading if validation alone is relaxed.
gaps.minimum_needed: An explicitly versioned, opt-in guided rigid-body kinematic map/ties for every selected body node, chosen free/held rigid modes and actual coordinates; retain source medium/kernel semantics without claiming high-E elasticity is rigid.

gaps.current_gap: Holding input d while independently changing body-q is not represented by one targets_mm vector, one b_in row and one scalar multiplier. Repeated d targets are forbidden; b_out is not an independently imposed mean constraint.
gaps.minimum_needed: An explicit two-control schedule and constrained/reduced equations: input mean held plus rigid body-q prescribed. A two-mean formulation needs two independent constraint columns/rows and reactions; a prescribed body-lift formulation still needs new moving-body constraints/reaction recovery and zero-support distinctions. Either requires deliberate source changes, not JSON alone.

gaps.current_gap: No native task field/public argument or controller residual term for an independent workpiece external load. Input R_input is a solved actuator reaction; cached body holding is support reaction, not an applied body load.
gaps.minimum_needed: If force control is selected, define guided-body generalized load/vector, sign, force units and half/full convention, add it to balance and work-conjugate reaction reporting. Prescribed-q resisting reaction and force-controlled free response are separate experiments.

gaps.current_gap: Existing read_native_resume forbids changed task/material/boundary/geometry and source/options changes. extend_path only appends the same original physical task; fixed body peak cannot directly seed a released/moving-body task through that API.
gaps.minimum_needed: Use a newly defined physical task. If later approved to transport an old state, specify a separate migration/initial-guess contract, rigid-map projection/admissibility and fresh new-task equilibrium/reactions; retain ancestry without inheriting old task qualification or matrices.

gaps.current_gap: Current observer checks every body DOF is fixed and reports model reference coordinates. Existing fixed-body views/report qualifiers cannot silently become moving-body/load-capacity results.
gaps.minimum_needed: Separate actual body position/control reaction/external-balance metadata and matching save/read/visualization schema; preserve old fixed_rigid reader and data. This is needed before any actual motion plot or new functional conclusion.

candidate_minimal_extension.physical_question: At a held gripper input, obtain a guided rigid-body horizontal extraction displacement/reaction response before any free-load or release claim.
candidate_minimal_extension.body_kinematics: If+x is chosen: all original body nodes share ux=q_body and uy=0, rotation fixed. An average alone does not impose rigidity.
candidate_minimal_extension.controls: Independent actuator mean d and guided body-q; explicit loading/holding/extraction order, separate input/body reactions. Numeric endpoints/physical success criteria must be fixed in the task specification, not chosen by this audit.
candidate_minimal_extension.symmetry: Guided horizontal translation with uy/rotation fixed can preserve current y-mirror only if loads/constraints are mirrored consistently. Vertical translation or general rotation does not preserve this half-body task; incompatible load needs a full model choice.
candidate_minimal_extension.constitutive_reuse: Existing NumPy force/tangent and20mm units may be reused only after compatible rigid-map/reduced assembly is implemented and checked; no friction law is introduced by unlocking or adding load.
candidate_minimal_extension.restart: Current fixed-body saved states are references only under existing public API. New physics requires new task/start contract; any future state transport needs a separate reviewed implementation and fresh new-task equilibrium.
candidate_minimal_extension.first_code_dependency: A separately approved minimal kinematic/control implementation and bounded small-model verification after physical specification; neither is started here.
candidate_minimal_extension.force_control_dependency: Nonzero external force on a contact-free free body need not admit static equilibrium. Solver failure/zero mode is not release; force control/free motion needs its own physical and stopping definition.

limits: Capability statements concern this traced native call path, not a claim that every unrelated repository tool was searched.
No changed JSON label unlocks true rigidity or an independent external-load control.
No old fixed-boundary task/status/SHA was modified or reused as new-physics acceptance.
Existing load_saved_study_report remains a read-only report function, not a solver or actuator.
